_comment: Per-product brand override for Algenta. The shared design system + interaction grammar + page archetypes + QA gates are FIXED in scripts/gitbook/shared-customization.json. Only brand varies here.
_favicon_logo: UI-MANAGED. GitBook has no upload API and this repo is private (raw URLs 404), so the favicon + Algenta wordmark (light + dark) are uploaded once in GitBook -> Customization -> Basic -> Icon/Logo. apply-customization.py never sets favicon/logo so re-running it can't clobber them.
